name: list_game_clients
description: Lists all simultaneously connected game clients (conn_id, PID, game_dir, char_id, char_name, scene_name, is_active). Call this or get_status when multiple accounts may be running so you can see every character.

name: select_game_client
description: Sets the default game client that MCP tools target (by character name, char_id, drive/path substring e.g. 'E:' or 'G:', PID, or conn_id). Use list_game_clients to inspect available clients, or pass the optional 'client' argument to any individual tool.

name: get_status
description: Returns the target player's state (HP, scene, channel line_id, 3D coordinates, party summary) and active behavior. When multiple game clients are connected, also includes active_conn_id and connected_clients so you can see every character.

name: get_party
description: Lists all party members with their name, char_id, leader status, scene, channel (line_id), AOI status, and position.

name: get_guild_members
description: Lists guild members (name, char_id, level, online status, current scene_id and scene_name).

name: get_social_roster
description:
Lists a unified, deduplicated UID roster across Party ('party'), Friends ('friend'), and Guild ('guild'), or 'all'.
Returns each player's numeric uid (char_id), name, online status, source_badge ([파티], [친구], [길드]), and scene.
Use this to disambiguate duplicate nicknames and select exact UIDs for follow_player or configure_chat_monitor.

name: follow_player
description:
Follows ANY player (party member, guild member, friend, chat sender, or numeric char_id) across maps, Guild Hall, and channels.
- target: Character name (e.g. '안도라'), numeric char_id, or 'leader' / '파티장'.
- stop_distance: Distance in meters to maintain from the target (default 2.5).
- continuous: If True (default), continuously follows the target as they walk or change maps/channels until stop() is called.
              If False, approaches the target once and stops automatically upon arrival.
- auto_teleport: Automatically enter Guild Hall / teleport to the target's map if on a different scene.
- auto_switch_channel: Automatically switch channel (line) to match the target.

name: follow_party_member
description:
Follows a party member (or 'leader' / '파티장').
- continuous: True (default) keeps following until stop() is called; False moves to them once and stops on arrival.

name: stop
description: Immediately stops any active movement or player-following behavior.

name: move_to
description: Moves the character once to the specified world coordinates (x, y, z) on the current map.

name: get_nearby_entities
description: Lists nearby in-AOI entities ('player', 'monster', or '' for all) sorted by distance.

name: get_recent_chats
description: Returns recent in-game chat messages (excluding noisy system notices).

name: send_chat
description: Sends an in-game chat message. channel can be 'party', 'say', 'world', 'guild', or 'whisper'.

name: set_auto_combat
description: Toggles (when enable is None) or sets built-in in-game Auto-Combat ('G' key feature).

name: list_channels
description: Lists current channel (line_id) and available channels on the active map.

name: switch_channel
description: Switches channel (scene line) to an explicit line_id or to a player's channel via char_id/target. Automatically stops any active player-following.

name: list_places
description:
Lists special hubs ('길드 이벤트 센터', '가든 주택' 마이홈) and open-world maps / warp points.
Provide an optional query (e.g. '길드', '아스텔리즈', '개척국', '바하마르') to filter destinations.

name: list_activities
description: Lists timed/casual attractions and event booth NPCs (such as Meteor Island / 유성도 limited-time events like '레이저 회전', '물고기 폭주', etc.) along with their NPC name, scene coordinates, and whether each activity is currently open.

name: teleport_to_place
description:
Immediately enters or teleports to a destination by name, alias, or ID:
- Guild Hall: '길드 홈', '길드홀', '길드 이벤트 센터'
- Personal Home: '마이홈', '내 집', '가든 주택'
- Exit current hub: '나가기', '퇴장'
- Any map or warp point name: '아스텔리즈', '개척국', '타륜 주점', '아스테리아 평원', '바하마르 고원', etc.

name: leave_special_scene
description: Exits Guild Hall ('길드 이벤트 센터') or Personal Home ('가든 주택') back to the open world.

name: inspect_skill_slots
description: Inspects currently equipped skill slots, names, and cooldown states on the character.

name: configure_locomotion
description: Updates 3-tier locomotion ('E' mobility skill, bunnyhop, combat tether) thresholds dynamically.

name: manage_party
description:
Manages the character's party:
- action='create': Creates a party (set auto_accept=True to automatically accept incoming join requests).
- action='set_auto_accept': Enables or disables auto-accepting join requests on the current party (auto_accept=True/False).
- action='set_member_type': Switches the party between 5-player and 20-player (raid) mode (size=5 or 20; leader only).
- action='join': Applies to join another player's party by player name/char_id ('target') or 'team_id'.
- action='merge': Party LEADER applies to merge into another player's party ('target' name/char_id or 'team_id'), keeping own party.
- action='leave': Leaves the current party.
- action='invite': Invites 'target' player to the party (creates a party first if solo).
- action='accept_apply': Approves all pending incoming party join applications.
- action='transfer_leader': Transfers party leadership to 'target' party member (name or UID; leader only).
- action='kick': Kicks 'target' from the party (leader only).

name: revive
description: Revives the character if dead (free options only: nearby → revive point → main city). dry_run=True only reports the chosen option.

name: ride
description: Mounts/dismounts the equipped Riding Imagine mount. action: 'mount' | 'dismount' | 'toggle'; ride_type: 'auto' | 'land' | 'water'.

name: accept_interaction
description:
Approves requests sent by 'target' (name/UID) within window_sec seconds.
kinds (comma list, empty = all): interaction (2-person action), ride (ride-together apply/invite), party (party invite).

name: request_ride
description: Sends a ride-together request to a NEARBY player. mode='apply': ride THEIR mount; mode='invite': let them ride OUR mount.

name: request_interaction
description: Sends a 2-person action request (default '손잡기') to a NEARBY player; they must accept it.

name: query_player_location
description: Looks up where a player is: map name/type, channel, coordinates, distance, and whether the map is enterable.

name: list_presets
description: Lists job/skill presets (loadouts) and outfit presets available to the current character.

name: switch_loadout
description: Switches the job/skill/talent/gear preset by 1-based number, preset name, or profession (id or Korean name).

name: switch_outfit
description: Switches to an outfit preset (from Stellar.WardrobeLoadout) by 1-based number or name; with neither, picks a random preset.

name: seek_monster
description: Travels (across maps if needed) to the nearest spawn point of a monster by name or id. engage=True turns on auto-combat on arrival.

name: gather_resource
description:
Integrates with Stellar.AutoGather to automatically teleport near the resource cluster, gather 'resource'
(e.g. '사향 분말', '부채조개', '속삭임 난초', or '주변' for any nearby node) 'count' times, and stop automatically.

name: list_gatherable_resources
description: Lists gatherable life-skill resources (name, ID, map area, focus cost) matching an optional Korean query.

name: list_fishing_spots
description: Lists fishing areas, landmarks, and catchable fish species dynamically from game tables (optionally filtered by Korean query).

name: fish
description:
Integrates with Stellar.AutoFishing to travel to a fishing spot (or nearest spot when spot=''),
equip rod & compatible bait, enter fishing stance, and auto-fish ('count' fish or continuously when count=0).

name: configure_chat_monitor
description:
Configures real-time in-game chat monitoring, wake triggers, and registered Admins.
- enabled: True to activate chat monitoring, False to stop.
- channels: Channels to watch, e.g. ['guild', 'party'] (also supports 'say', 'world', 'whisper').
- trigger_words: Optional list of trigger keywords (empty responds to ALL chat in monitored channels; whisper always bypasses).
- authorized_commanders: List of Admin character names or char_ids allowed to run Admin-Only (🔒) features and change locks.

name: get_chat_monitor_status
description: Returns current chat monitor configuration, local AGY CLI readiness, and recent handled chat triggers.

name: get_bot_goals
description: Returns the per-bot GoalManager state (active goal, paused resume stack, queued goals, autonomous config).

name: cancel_bot_goal
description: Cancels an active, paused, or queued goal on the selected bot (or all goals when cancel_all=True).

name: set_autonomous_mode
description: Toggles per-bot autonomous idle mode (default OFF) and optional manual-input grace window in seconds.

name: get_rule_promotion_candidates
description: Returns repeated LLM exception-consultation patterns eligible for promotion into deterministic rules.

name: get_bot_memories
description: Queries persistent SQLite memories and recent events partitioned by `char_id` (or the active client's character).

name: save_bot_memory
description: Saves or updates a persistent memory entry (`preference`, `relationship`, `nickname_alias`, `habit`, `note`) for the selected bot character.

name: delete_bot_memory
description: Deletes stored memories matching `memory_id` or `mem_key` for the selected bot character.

name: get_known_users
description: Lists shared player UID records and observed nickname change history across all bots.

name: get_item_count
description: Queries live bag inventory counts (materials, consumables, currency, vitality) by Korean item name or item_id.

name: get_recipe
description: Queries live recipe details across life crafting, cooking, alchemy, housing furniture, and equip forge.

name: plan_craft
description: Deterministically expands a crafting dependency tree against live inventory and SQLite cached recipes without executing.

count.description: Item quantity or craft batch count (0 = craft max possible until Focus/Vitality is exhausted).
count.title: Count

count_mode.description: Counting mode: additional (output N more items), total_target (reach N total owned), crafts (execute recipe N times regardless of yield), or max_focus (craft maximum times within available Focus/Vitality).
count_mode.title: Count Mode

name: start_craft_goal
description: Plans and enqueues/starts a multi-stage crafting Goal (gather -> fish -> sub-craft -> final craft; asks before monster hunting unless allow_monster_farm=True).

count.description: Item quantity or craft batch count (0 = craft max possible until Focus/Vitality is exhausted).
count.title: Count

count_mode.description: Counting mode: additional (output N more items), total_target (reach N total owned), crafts (execute recipe N times regardless of yield), or max_focus (craft maximum times within available Focus/Vitality).
count_mode.title: Count Mode

name: wait_for_chat_trigger
description: Waits for the next triggered chat message when chat monitor is running with use_local_agy=False.

name: play_emote
description:
Plays a standalone emote/action on the active character (e.g. emote='박수', '댄스', '앉기', '인사', '죽은 척하기'),
or stops any ongoing continuous emote when stop=True (or emote='중지'). Silently skips if unowned.

name: list_emotes
description: Lists all unlocked emotes (ID, Korean name, looping flag) available on the active character.

name: list_dungeons
description:
Lists enterable dungeons, Unstable Spaces ('unstable'), Master Mode dungeons ('master'), Raids ('raid'),
and Boss activities matching an optional Korean query.

name: enter_dungeon
description:
Starts entry into a dungeon, Master Mode tier (e.g. difficulty='마스터 5'), Unstable Space ('불안정 공간'),
Raid ('회귀'/'혈전'/'결전' or '이지'/'하드'/'나이트메어'; auto-converts 5-man party to 20-man raid when needed),
Sidimoon Tower, or World Boss ('월드 보스') when the character is solo or the party leader.

name: ready_check
description: Manually confirms any active dungeon / raid / Unstable Space / World Boss ready-check popup immediately.

name: list_stickers
description: Lists owned in-game chat picture stickers and supported semantic mood tags ('greet', 'thanks', 'thumbsup', 'cheer', 'heart', 'laugh', 'cute', 'ok', 'think', 'sorry', 'sad', 'random').

name: send_sticker
description:
Sends an owned built-in picture sticker to an in-game chat channel ('party', 'guild', 'whisper', etc.).
- sticker: Semantic mood tag ('greet', 'thanks', 'thumbsup', 'cheer', 'heart', 'laugh', 'cute', 'ok', 'think', 'sorry', 'sad', 'random'), resource substring, or ID string.

name: leave_dungeon
description: Immediately exits the current Dungeon, Master Mode, Unstable Space, 20-Man Raid, Sidimoon Tower, World Boss, Visual Layer, Guild Hall, or Personal Home.

name: list_gimmicks
description: Lists nearby interactive traversal field/dungeon gimmicks (Wind Tunnels, Glider Launches, Intra-map Teleporters) excluding dungeon exits, chests, seats, and fishing spots.

name: use_gimmick
description: Approaches and activates a nearby traversal field/dungeon gimmick (e.g. '바람의 통로', '순간 이동', or nearest available if query is empty).

name: set_eco_mode
description: Switches in-game resource saving mode ('off' | 'standard' | 'ultra' black-screen + texture mipmap + OnDemandRendering throttle).

name: trim_memory
description: Runs Unity Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets and Win32 EmptyWorkingSet inside the active game client.

name: list_quests
description: Lists non-hidden quests sorted top-to-bottom by UI order or prioritized by region, with optional category ('구역 퀘스트', '스토리', '후일담', '가이드 퀘스트', '인연 스토리', '이벤트 퀘스트'), region/map filter, and name query.

name: auto_quest
description: Tracks and sequentially runs eligible quests within a category (e.g. '구역 퀘스트', '스토리', '후일담', '가이드 퀘스트'), optional region priority/filter (e.g. '바하마르 고원', '아스테리아 평원', '현재 지역'), or matching query, automatically skipping dialog/cutscenes and moving across maps.

name: auto_interact
description: Repeatedly presses eligible in-range [F] interaction prompts until stopped, count reached, or duration elapses. When 'activity' (or 'activity_id') is provided (e.g. '레이저 회전', '유성도 한정'), dynamically locates the NPC, navigates to them across maps/portals, and keeps re-entering until stopped.
